held.headline: Trump and Xi meet in Washington as US-China trade truce is extended
held.reason: Fresh consequential US-China diplomacy independently corroborated by Reuters and AP. The White House has official event material, but this cycle did not establish a complete legally defensible still-image reuse package with an exact image asset, dimensions, and reuse basis suitable for FMB publication across jurisdictions. Held rather than assuming that appearance on a federal website alone clears every image for reuse.

held.headline: Russian drone and missile strikes kill at least eight civilians in Ukraine
held.reason: Fresh active-conflict casualty reporting is independently corroborated by Reuters and an Associated Press report carried by ABC News. Available Reuters/AP documentary photographs are licensed news-agency material; no independent reusable event image with complete source, creator, licence/reuse basis, dimensions, caption and alt text was cleared in this cycle. Held rather than republishing licensed wire photography without permission.

held.reason: Reuters and AP both report market pressure and investor focus on oil, bonds and the Trump-Xi talks. The sourcing gate passed, but this cycle did not establish a relevant rights-cleared market image package meeting FMB's required source, credit, caption, alt-text, dimensions and reuse-basis fields.

audit.note: Fresh September 24 reporting was researched only from approved professional newsrooms for factual claims. High-impact items were independently corroborated where reasonably possible. Stories that cleared sourcing but not the complete image-rights gate were held. No documentary image was fabricated and no wire-service photograph was treated as reusable merely because it appeared with an article.
